primary: SELECT SUM(balance) AS total,AVG(balance) AS mean,COUNT(*) AS n FROM bank_loan WHERE age BETWEEN 30 AND 40 AND education='primary'
primary_secondary: SELECT SUM(balance) AS total,AVG(balance) AS mean,COUNT(*) AS n FROM bank_loan WHERE age BETWEEN 30 AND 40 AND education IN ('primary','secondary')
age_frequency: SELECT age,COUNT(*) AS n FROM bank_loan WHERE age BETWEEN 30 AND 40 AND education IN ('primary','secondary') GROUP BY age ORDER BY age
